explication: Strix is an AI-powered penetration-testing platform. A user launches a local or cloud scan, configuration and targets enter the runner, which coordinates multiple agents inside per-scan Docker sandboxes. Agents use reconnaissance, proxy, terminal, MCP, threat-model and coverage tools to investigate targets and validate exploits. Findings and scan state become reports, coverage records and transcripts, then the CLI, TUI or browser viewer presents results and remediation-oriented output. The graph preserves documented cloud, reporting and live-observation branches; several internal call paths remain inferred from module responsibilities because only sampled excerpts were provided.
